caption: The drawing depicts a small, beige pouch with a diagonal ribbed texture. The pouch features two handles or straps at the top, which are made of a soft material and colored pink. At the base of each handle, there is a gathered, rosette-like embellishment, also in pink, attached to the sides of the pouch. A third, larger pink rosette is centered on the lower half of the pouch. The overall shape of the pouch is slightly flared, with a somewhat angular, geometric outline, and its edges are bordered with subtle stitching. The drawing background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature, "Carl Buegertniss," is written in small letters on the lower right side of the image.
title: Handbag
